strictCommand.text: optional string; room chat only; max500

rules: No game is enabled by descriptive players metadata or default2; exact approved item/content/platform/engine/core/runtime/profile/mode identity is required.
Profiles can classify single-player; maximumPlayers1 denies create/join/start for multiplayer.

Host slot1; waiting membership changes generation and compacts slots1..N. Start freezes actual roster and slots, requiring its count in allowedPlayerCounts; capacity itself must also be allowed. A transient3rd member may join capacity4 when allowed counts are2and4, but cannot start as3.
All participants must ready the current generation. Join/leave before start changes generation and clears ready flags.
Start returns a private connectionPassword only to room members; public room list excludes it.
Ticket is single-use, proof-bound, owner/link/slot/room/generation-bound. A guest cannot request another guest link. Host requests each link separately.
The native host must bind each accepted TCP connection to guestSlot from the authenticated link; arrival order is not slot identity.

Any dropped endpoint pauses the whole room and advances the global epoch. Replay windows survive reconnect. Every endpoint must pause and become ready in this epoch; all windows must drain before Playing.
The native emulator must pause once globally; only control/synchronization traffic may progress while paused. Java link-local readiness cannot independently resume the core.
Network loss retains the logical room; explicit leave/revocation ends it. Process restart cannot recover in-memory streams.

V2 wire stays unchanged. Enabling v3 requires the authoritative legacy capacity gate. The gate permits new v2 create/join/start only for an exact approved standard-2p-v1 profile supporting2; unknown, single-player and multitap profiles are rejected. Already started v2 sessions retain heartbeat/tickets/recovery. No v3 fallback to v2.

POST requires an existing authenticated social enter. selfId and nickname come from the v2 authority, never a client-supplied peer ID. A retained v3 room retains its public identity across offline/expiry.

capabilities/snapshot/heartbeat return rooms and own roster; profiles are returned only for command.itemId or the own-room item, max32 exact variants. profileCount counts registry entries; absence is pending, never inferred2.
ticket/resume require all profile identity fields and protected proof mode. ready/start/leave/failed/chat bind roomId+generation to authenticated membership; ready/start validate the stored profile.
failed marks a started room unrecoverable and retains it until explicit leave. recoveryStarted remains true after the first global Playing.
Chat is room-only, at most32 messages and64KiB, max500 characters/message and1/second. Public rooms omit private messages and password. V3 invitations are not yet implemented.

Social blocks are bidirectional and authoritative for v3. Public snapshots hide rooms containing any blocked member; join checks all roster members. A successful human social block leaves the actor from a shared waiting room, or ends the shared frozen room, while preserving unrelated rooms. Admission and social block effects share AdmissionGate; v3 receives a copied block set to avoid lock inversion.

DATA advancing the accepted offset invalidates READY only for both endpoints of the affected link. Unchanged links and duplicate DATA retain their watermark readiness. The global epoch/paused/ready and all-window-drained barrier still governs resume.
connectionPasswordFormat: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (32 random bytes), private own room only
